item.title: dsh's Composer Started Guessing What You'll Say: 512 Tokens Buys Your Opening Move
item.description: DeepSeek Harness's community plugins give the dsh composer a 'guess what you'll say' layer: after each agent turn, ghost text drafts your next prompt and Tab adopts it. Bounded 512-token LLM calls plus local zsh-style prefix completion, with redaction and no core changes.

item.title: React Slept for 11 Months, Then Shipped 5 New APIs: I Ran All of Them, Two Surprised Me
item.description: React 19.3 is the first feature release of 19.x in 11 months: Fragments take refs, RSC renders Context directly, ViewTransition is stable, browser() opts client components out of SSR, and Trusted Types now works with React. I ran all five on react@19.3.0 + Next 16.3.8. Two things matched none of the writeups I'd read — Fragment ref.current is not a node array, and Next 15 ships a bundled react-dom 19.2 under your nose.
